source_caption:
Few stories have shaped the world of art as profoundly and enduringly as The Odyssey.

For nearly 3,000 years, Homer’s epic has inspired artists to bring its legendary characters, monsters, and adventures to life—each reflecting the story through the artistic language and cultural lens of their own era.

From the terrifying Cyclops and the seductive Sirens to the treacherous passage between Scylla and Charybdis, and Odysseus’ unwavering journey home, these works show how a timeless story can be continually reimagined across generations.

The story remains the same. The way we see it never does.

Have you seen The Odyssey yet? What did you think? 💭
